classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct local/mock-only assertion blocks coexist with material actual boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Connected source/mapping evidence insufficient to support a category; separate from runtime UNKNOWN.

assertion_evidence.text:
for _, invalid := range []string{"id", "node", "owner", "create-key", "generation", "region", "stopped", "mesh-ip", "public-ip", "loopback", "ambiguous"} {
		t.Run(invalid, func(t *testing.T) {
			selected, instance := netbirdInventoryHost("recovering", "10.251.0.21")
			switch invalid {
			case "id":
				instance.ID = "another-instance"
			case "node":
				instance.Node = "another-node"
			case "owner":
				instance.Owner = "another-owner"
			case "create-key":
				instance.CreateKey = "another-create"
			case "generation":
				instance.Generation++
			case "region":
				instance.Region = oci.RegionSFO
			case "stopped":
				instance.State = "STOPPED"
			case "mesh-ip":
				instance.PrivateIP = "10.200.1.2"
			case "public-ip":
				instance.PrivateIP = "8.8.8.8"
			case "loopback":
				instance.PrivateIP = "127.0.0.1"
			}
			fleet := &netbirdInventoryFleet{instances: []oci.Instance{instance}}
			if invalid == "ambiguous" {
				duplicate := instance
				duplicate.ID = "duplicate-node"
				fleet.instances = append(fleet.instances, duplicate)
			}
			n := netbirdRollout{fence: &releaseFence{hosts: &netbirdInventoryHosts{statuses: []host.HostStatus{selected}},
				spec: func() (*cellspec.ReleaseFence, map[string]string) { return nil, nil }}, fleet: fleet}
			if err := n.refreshRecoveryNode(t.Context(), selected.Registration.Node); err == nil || len(n.managedAddresses) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("accepted %s recovery identity: addresses=%v error=%v", invalid, n.managedAddresses, err)
			}

qualification_limits: Source-only candidate pending distinct peer review; no ledger/count promotion, retirement, deletion or runtime qualification.
No Go/build/test/helper/process/probe/cloud/download execution, repository mutation, resource/lock action or child agent.
All test declarations match baseline and survival hashes; canonical hash/body drift checked explicitly.
Embedded NATS is local single-server fixture, with synthetic ELF payloads; no upstream NetBird daemon, OCI/Vault, live mesh, actual controller authority journal or fleet failover qualification.

Bootstrap defaults uses actual config-file loading but substitutes production ReadBootstrapConfig; managed status/install/confirm/enroll are callbacks. Root-owned config runtime applicability is unqualified.

Actual reached broker startup is direct server.NewServer/Start in netbirdArtifactTest and fenceBroker; clients use nats.Connect(ClientURL) over loopback TCP. Neither fixture calls natscell.Start or selects nats.InProcessServer; no in-process transport, TLS/JWT, multiserver or cloud admission coverage inferred.
